grid_rule: JRC 2020 class read at each Hansen cell centre; the JRC lattice nests the Hansen lattice by an odd integer ratio, so the centre is a JRC cell centre
limitations: The rule is JRC 2020 read at each Hansen cell centre, the middle cell of a 3x3 block; JRC sub-cell detail is dropped, not reproduced.
Dropped attributes are listed, not called lossless: treecover2000, loss years 2001-2020 and, at eudr-decision.v1, loss years on JRC non-forest land.
Counts are Hansen cells, not hectares; no area is inferred.
Outputs are mapped observations from public layers, not legal compliance findings.
Equality is proved against the original layers under the shared selection rule, not against satellite ground truth.
The real chip has no datamask-0 cells and no invalid masks; nodata and mask-invalid branches are covered by the synthetic unit tests.

dropped_detail.note: not in either contract, so changing them must change no code

theorem: Each contract output is a function of (the multiset of selected in-chip cell codes, the out-of-chip selected count). If the code of every Hansen cell derived from the original layers equals the stored code, then for every valid Polygon or MultiPolygon the stored path returns exactly the original-layers output under the shared centre rule (engine.query.select_cells). Exhaustive cell equality therefore implies equality for all polygons, not just the 17 plots.

v1_crosscheck.note: v1 and the decision layers both treat a cell as known only if all three Hansen masks are valid (the real chip has no invalid masks).
